name: ProceedToCart
usage_hint: Full-page CTA button that navigates to /cart or /checkout. Buy Now mode adds item + redirects; Proceed to Checkout mode is a direct link.
when_to_use: For prominent checkout CTAs on product pages (Buy Now) or as a cart page footer button (Proceed to Checkout). This navigates to a full page instead of opening the default Cart V2 drawer. Supports variant:changed event listening.
when_not_to_use: For add-to-cart without redirect use BuyBox. When you want users to stay on page after adding, rely on the effective Cart V2 profile for drawer feedback.
anti_patterns: Using ProceedToCart AND BuyBox on the same product page (redundant CTA confusion)
Setting checkoutUrl to /cart when you mean /checkout (different pages)
Passing variantId without OptionResolver or VariantSelector to keep it synced (stale variant on option change)
